specs.Performance: 3GB RAM with expandable storage up to 8GB, running on Android 15 Go Edition for smooth performance.
specs.Display/Build: Features a large 6.75" HD+ punch-hole display with a 60Hz refresh rate, though build quality is modest.
specs.Battery/Features: Equipped with a 5000mAh battery for extended use, supports fingerprint and face unlock for security.

review_html:
Overview

Lava Bold N2 Lite ek budget-friendly smartphone hai jo 6.75" HD+ display, 13MP AI dual rear camera aur 5000mAh battery ke saath aata hai. Yeh device Android 15 Go Edition par chalta hai aur isme 3GB RAM aur 64GB storage hai, jisse multitasking smooth hoti hai. Type-C charging se battery jaldi charge hoti hai.

Why Buy This?

Agar aapko ek affordable smartphone chahiye jo achi display aur camera performance de, toh Lava Bold N2 Lite aapke liye ek accha option hai, lekin heavy multitasking ke liye shayad yeh thoda limit ho sakta hai.
